name: compost
description: One software-engineering workflow composted from Matt Pocock's skills, superpowers, pstack, Imbue's blueprint, and autonomous-sdlc: specs with BDD acceptance criteria, tracer-bullet issues in your tracker, builds that fit tests into the existing suite, automatic subagent review, browser diff review, semantic lint for Python, a prune skill that keeps docs to what the code can't say, and a turn skill that works in upstream changes.
